en.extract: Abdul Latiff bin Abdul Rahman is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Kuala Krai since May 2018. He previously served as Member of the Kelantan State Legislative Assembly (MLA) for Mengkebang from March 2008 to May 2018. He is a member and the Division Chief of Kuala Krai of the Malaysian Islamic Party (PAS), a component party of the Perikatan Nasional (PN) coalition. As MP for Kuala Krai, he supported the cancellation of concerts in Malaysia and called a Bollywood concert insensitive.

en.extract: Fadhlina binti Sidek is a Malaysian politician and lawyer who has served as the Minister of Education in the Unity Government administration under Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim since December 2022 and the Member of Parliament (MP) for Nibong Tebal since November 2022. She served as a Senator from September 2021 to her resignation in November 2022. She is a member of the People's Justice Party (PKR), a component party of the PH coalition. She has also served as the Women Chief of PKR since July 2022. She is also the first female Minister of Education in Malaysian history.

ms.extract: Datuk Seri Fadhlina binti Sidek ialah seorang ahli politik dan peguam Malaysia yang kini berkhidmat sebagai Menteri Pendidikan dalam pentadbiran Kerajaan Perpaduan di bawah pimpinan Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim sejak Disember 2022 serta Ahli Parlimen (AP) bagi Nibong Tebal sejak November 2022. en.extract: Anwar bin Ibrahim is a Malaysian politician who has served as the 10th prime minister of Malaysia since 2022. A member of the People's Justice Party (PKR), he served as Member of Parliament (MP) for Tambun since 2022. Upon becoming prime minister, he appointed himself Minister of Finance. Anwar is also the president of PKR since 2018 and the chairman of Pakatan Harapan coalition since 2020.

ms.extract: Anwar bin Ibrahim ialah Perdana Menteri Malaysia yang ke-10 dan Menteri Kewangan Malaysia sejak 2022. Beliau sebelum ini merupakan ahli politik Malaysia yang telah menjadi ketua pembangkang ke-12 dan ke-16 dari 2008 hingga 2015 dan sekali lagi dari 2020 hingga 2022, pengerusi Pakatan Harapan (PH) sejak 2020 dan presiden Parti Keadilan Rakyat (PKR) sejak 2018. Beliau telah bertugas sebagai ahli parlimen Port Dickson dari Oktober 2018 sehingga November 2022 dan Permatang Pauh dari Mac 1982 sehingga April 1999 dan sekali lagi dari Ogos 2008 hingga Mac 2015. en.extract: M. Kula Segaran s/o V. Murugeson, commonly known as Kula, is a Malaysian politician and lawyer. He has served as Deputy Minister in the Prime Minister's Department in charge of Laws and Institutional Reforms in the Unity Government under Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim and Minister Azalina Othman Said since December 2023. He has represented Ipoh Barat in the Dewan Rakyat since 2004.

ms.extract: Yang Berhormat Tuan M. Kula Segaran a/l V. Murugeson, juga dikenali sebagai Kula, ialah seorang ahli politik dan peguam Malaysia. Beliau telah berkhidmat sebagai Timbalan Menteri Jabatan Perdana Menteri ]] di bawah Kerajaan Perpaduan pimpinan Perdana Menteri Anwar Ibrahim dan Menteri Azalina Othman Said sejak Disember 2023. Beliau telah mewakili Ipoh Barat di Dewan Rakyat sejak 2004.

legislative.name: YB Tuan M.Kulasegaran a/l V.Murugeson

en.extract: Sivakumar s/o Varatharaju Naidu, better known as V. Sivakumar, is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Batu Gajah since May 2013. He served as the Minister of Human Resources in the Unity Government administration under Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim from December 2022 to December 2023 and Member of the Perak State Legislative Assembly (MLA) for Tronoh from March 2008 to May 2013. He also served as Speaker of the assembly from April 2008 to May 2009. He is a member of the Democratic Action Party (DAP), a component party of the Pakatan Harapan (PH) and former

ms.extract: Sivakumar A/L Varatharaju Naidu merupakan ahli politik Malaysia dari Parti Tindakan Demokratik (DAP). Kini, beliau merupakan Ahli Parlimen bagi kerusi Batu Gajah sejak 2013, dan bekas ADUN kawasan Tronoh, Negeri Perak, Malaysia. Beliau menjadi orang India pertama menjadi Speaker Dewan Undangan Negeri Perak dan juga di Malaysia selepas menggantikan Junus Wahid (2000-2008). Beliau kini merupakan Menteri Sumber Manusia negara, serta menteri tunggal berbangsa India dalam jemaah menteri terkini negara.

legislative.name: YB Dr. Sivakumar a/l Varatharaju Naidu

en.extract: Iskandar Dzulkarnain bin Abdul Khalid is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Kuala Kangsar since November 2022 and had served as a Senator from 2021 until 2022. He was a member of the Malaysian United Indigenous Party (BERSATU), a component party of the Perikatan Nasional (PN) coalition. Currently, he is an independent politician since his BERSATU membership ended on 12 June 2024.

ms.extract: Datuk Iskandar Dzulkarnain bin Abdul Khalid ialah seorang ahli politik di Malaysia.

en.extract: Ustaz Haji Muhammad Ismi bin Mat Taib is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Parit since November 2022. He is a member and the Yang di-Pertua of Parit of the Malaysian Islamic Party (PAS), a component party of Perikatan Nasional (PN). As the MP for Parit, he called for the cancellation of beauty pageants in Malaysia, alleging that beauty pageants featuring revealing outfits could bring calamities.

en.extract: Chong Zhemin is a Malaysian politician and accountant who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Kampar since November 2022. He served as Member of the Perak State Legislative Assembly (MLA) for Keranji from May 2018 to November 2022. He is a member of the Democratic Action Party (DAP), a component party of the Pakatan Harapan (PH) coalition. He is the Chief of Economic Development Bureau of DAP of	Perak and was the Political Secretary to National Vice Chairman, Parliamentary Leader and State Chairman of DAP of Perak Nga Kor Ming.

en.extract: Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi is a Malaysian politician who is the deputy prime minister since 2022. A president of UMNO since 2018, he represented Bagan Datuk in Dewan Rakyat since 1995. Zahid is also the rural and regional development minister since 2022, as well as the leader and the chairman of the coalition Barisan Nasional (BN) since May 2018.

ms.extract: Ahmad Zahid bin Hamidi merupakan seorang ahli politik Malaysia yang telah berkhidmat sebagai Timbalan Perdana Menteri semasa pentadbiran dari 2015 sehingga 2018 dalam kerajaan Barisan Nasional kepada Perdana Menteri Dato' Sri Mohd. Najib Tun Razak dan juga dalam kerajaan perpaduan kepada Perdana Menteri Dato' Seri Anwar Ibrahim sejak 2022. Beliau merupakan tokoh Malaysia berketurunan Jawa, di mana bapanya berketurunan bangsawan Jawa dengan gelaran raden. Malah, kedua-dua ibu bapanya dilahirkan di Hindia Belanda, kemudian berpindah ke Persekutuan Tanah Melayu untuk bekerja. Dilahirkan di Perak.

en.extract: Chow Yu Hui is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Raub since November 2022. He served as Member of the Pahang State Legislative Assembly (MLA) for Tras from May 2018 to November 2022 and for Bilut from May 2013 to May 2018. He is a member of the Democratic Action Party (DAP), a component party of the Pakatan Harapan (PH) and formerly Pakatan Rakyat (PR) coalitions.

en.extract: Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin is a Malaysian politician and engineer who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Jerantut since November 2022. He had served as a Senator from December 2020 to his resignation in November 2022 to contest in the 2022 Malaysian general election. He is a member of the Malaysian Islamic Party (PAS), a component party of the Perikatan Nasional (PN) coalition. He has also served as the Information Chief of PAS since November 2021. He served as the Youth Chief of PN from November 2020 to January 2022 and of PAS from June 2019 to November 2021.

ms.extract: Ir. Ts. Haji Khairil Nizam bin Khirudin adalah ahli politik Malaysia berbangsa Melayu dari Parti Islam Se-Malaysia. Di peringkat parti, beliau merupakan Ketua Dewan Pemuda PAS Malaysia dari 2019 hingga 2021 dan Ketua Penerangannya sejak 2021.

en.extract: Young Syefura Othman, nicknamed Rara, is a Malaysian politician and nurse who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Bentong since November 2022. She served as Member of the Pahang State Legislative Assembly (MLA) for Ketari from May 2018 to November 2022. She is a member of the Democratic Action Party, a component party of the Pakatan Harapan (PH) and formerly Pakatan Rakyat (PR) coalitions. She has served as the Assistant National Publicity Secretary of DAP since March 2025, Vice Women Chief of DAP since September 2023 and State Vice Chairperson of DAP of Pahang since September 2024

ms.extract: Puan Young Syefura binti Othman juga dikenali sebagai Rara ialah seorang barua DAP wanita Malaysia. Beliau ialah Ahli Parlimen Bentong, Pahang. Beliau juga merupakan Ahli Lembaga Pengarah bagi Lembaga Pemasaran Pertanian Persekutuan (FAMA).

contact.address: P7 & P7-1, Jalan BG 2, Pusat Perniagaan Bintang Gemilang, 28700 Bentong, Pahang Darul Makmur.

en.extract: Ismail Sabri bin Yaakob is a Malaysian politician and lawyer who was the ninth prime minister of Malaysia from 2021 to 2022. A member of UMNO, he served as Member of Parliament (MP) for Bera since 2004. Ismail previously was the deputy prime minister in 2021.

en.extract: Mohd Rafizi bin Ramli is a Malaysian politician who served as the Minister of Economy from 2022 until his resignation in 2025. A member of the Malaysian United Party, he served as Member of Parliament (MP) for Pandan from 2013 to 2018 and from 2022 to 2026.

Pada peringkat parti, beliau memegang jawatan sebagai Timbalan Presiden Parti Keadilan Rakyat dari tahun 2022 hingga 2025, selepas dikalahkan oleh Nurul Izzah Anwar pada pemilihan kepimpinan PKR 2025. en.extract: Mohd Sany bin Hamzan is a Malaysian politician and teacher who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Hulu Langat since November 2022. en.extract: Yeo Bee Yin is a Malaysian politician and chemical engineer who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Puchong since 2022. She previously represented Bakri in the Dewan Rakyat from 2018 to 2022 and served as the Member of the Selangor State Legislative Assembly (MLA) for Damansara Utama from 2013 to 2018.

en.extract: Ramanan Ramakrishnan is a Malaysian politician of Indian descent. He has served as the Minister of Human Resources as part of the Anwar Ibrahim cabinet since December 2025. He became the first Malaysian of Tamil origin to hold a full ministerial portfolio after a hiatus of two years. He has been Member of Parliament (MP) for Sungai Buloh since November 2022, and is also a Vice President of People's Justice Party, having secured the second-highest number of votes in the 2025 party election.

ms.extract: Dato' Sri Ramanan Ramakrishnan ialah ahli politik Malaysia berketurunan India. Beliau kini berkhidmat sebagai Menteri Sumber Manusia Malaysia. Sebelumnya adalah Timbalan Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi Malaysia dan Ahli Parlimen Sungai Buloh mewakili PH-PKR.Beliau berkhidmat sebagai Pengerusi Jawatankuasa Khas Unit Transformasi Masyarakat India Malaysia (MITRA) dari April 2023 hingga Februari 2024.

en.extract: Hannah Yeoh Tseow Suan is a Malaysian politician and lawyer who has served as the Minister in the Prime Minister's Department in charge of the Federal Territories since 2025. She served as the Minister of Youth and Sports from 2022 to 2025. A member of the Democratic Action Party, she was the first female and the youngest speaker serving at the Selangor State Legislative Assembly from 2013 to 2018.

en.extract: Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad is a Malaysian politician who served as the Minister of Natural Resources and Environmental Sustainability in the administration of Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim from 2023 to 2025. He served as Member of Parliament (MP) for Setiawangsa from 2018 to 2026. He is a member of the Parti Bersama Malaysia (BERSAMA).

ms.extract: Nik Nazmi bin Nik Ahmad ialah ahli politik Malaysia berketurunan Melayu. Beliau kini berkhidmat sebagai ahli kabinet Perdana Menteri Malaysia ke-10, YAB Dato' Seri Anwar Ibrahim dengan memegang Portfolio sebagai Menteri Sumber Asli dan Kelestarian Alam Malaysia dan Ahli Parlimen Setiawangsa. Pada peringkat parti, beliau memegang jawatan sebagai Naib Presiden Parti Keadilan Rakyat. Pada 28 Mei 2025, beliau mengumumkan meletakkan Jawatan sebagai Menteri Sumber Asli dan Kelestarian Alam Malaysia berkuatkuasa 4 Julai 2025 dan mengumumkan akan mula bercuti bermula 29 Mei 2025 sehingga 3 Julai 2025.

en.extract: Fong Kui Lun is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Bukit Bintang since November 1999 and Klang from October 1990 to April 1995. He is a member of Democratic Action Party (DAP), a component party of the Pakatan Harapan (PH) and formerly Pakatan Rakyat (PR), Barisan Alternatif (BA) as well as Gagasan Rakyat (GR) coalitions. He also served as the National Treasurer of DAP from 1999 to 2025. He is also presently the oldest MP at the age of 78.

ms.extract: Fong Kui Lun merupakan Ahli Parlimen Bukit Bintang, Kuala Lumpur dari DAP. Dalam Pilihan Raya Umum Malaysia 2008 beliau mengalahkan calon dari Barisan Nasional, Datuk Lee Chong Meng dengan majoriti sebanyak 14,277 undi. Beliau memperolehi 26,811 undi berbanding lawannya memperolehi hanya 17,314 undi.

bio.name: Wan Azizah Wan Ismail
bio.photo_credit: Pocket News from Malaysia · CC BY 2.0

en.extract: Wan Azizah binti Wan Ismail is a Malaysian politician and the current spouse of the prime minister of Malaysia as the wife of Anwar Ibrahim. She first entered parliament in 1999, and has served as Member of Parliament (MP) for Bandar Tun Razak since 2022 as a member of the People's Justice Party. She is the first woman to serve as deputy prime minister of Malaysia, a position she held from 2018 to 2020.

ms.extract: Dato' Seri Dr. Hajah Wan Azizah binti Dato' Dr. Wan Ismail merupakan ahli politik dan juga bekas Timbalan Perdana Menteri wanita pertama di Malaysia dan juga bekas Presiden Parti Keadilan Rakyat. Beliau juga pernah menjadi Menteri Pembangunan Wanita Keluarga dan Masyarakat hingga tahun 2020 dan kini merupakan Ahli Parlimen Bandar Tun Razak, selepas senarai Kabinet telah diumumkan oleh Perdana Menteri yang baru dilantik, Tun Dr Mahathir Mohamad. Beliau merupakan wanita pertama yang memegang jawatan politik tertinggi di Malaysia. Di peringkat parti, beliau ialah Presiden Pakatan Harapan.

bio.name: Muhyiddin Yassin
bio.photo_credit: Universiti Malaysia Sarawak Malaysia from Kuching, Malaysia · CC BY 2.0

en.extract: Mahiaddin bin Md. Yasin, commonly known as Muhyiddin Yassin, is a Malaysian politician and civil servant who served as the eighth prime minister of Malaysia from 2020 until his resignation in 2021 after losing parliamentary support amid the 2020–2022 political crisis. A president of BERSATU, he represented Pagoh in Dewan Rakyat since 1995 and previously served as the Menteri Besar of Johor from 1986 to 1995.

ms.extract: Yang Berhormat Tan Sri Dato' (Dr.) Haji Muhyiddin bin Haji Md Yassin merupakan Perdana Menteri Malaysia ke-8 dari Mac 2020 sehingga Ogos 2021. Susulan peletakan jawatannya, beliau menjawat jawatan sebagai caretaker Perdana Menteri Malaysia dari 16 sehingga 21 Ogos 2021, di mana kemudiannya YB Dato' Sri Ismail Sabri Yaakob dilantik sebagai Perdana Menteri Malaysia ke-9. Pada September 2021, beliau dilantik sebagai Pengerusi Majlis Pemulihan Negara bertaraf Menteri oleh Perdana Menteri Malaysia, YB Dato' Sri Ismail Sabri Yaakob.

legislative.name: YB Tan Sri Dato' Haji Mahiaddin bin Md Yasin

contact.address: No.5, Jalan Setiabakti 7, Bukit Damansara, 50490 Kuala Lumpur.

en.extract: Syed Saddiq bin Syed Abdul Rahman is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Muar since May 2018. A founder and member of Malaysian United Democratic Alliance, he is the youngest federal minister in the country serving as the Minister of Youth and Sports in the Pakatan Harapan (PH) administration from July 2018 until the collapse of the administration in February 2020. At 33, Saddiq is presently the third youngest MP.

en.extract: Hishammuddin bin Hussein is a Malaysian politician and lawyer who served as Senior Minister of the Security Cluster and Minister of Defence from 2021 to 2022. A member of the United Malays National Organisation (UMNO), a component party of the Barisan Nasional (BN) coalition, he has been a Member of Parliament (MP) for Sembrong since 2004, having previously been an MP for Tenggara from 1995 to 2004.

bio.photo_credit: U.S. Secretary of Defense · CC BY 2.0

en.extract: Mohamed Khaled bin Nordin is a Malaysian	politician who has served as the Minister of Defence since December 2023 and previously served as the Minister of Higher Education prior to the 2023 cabinet reshuffle for the second term from December 2022 to December 2023 in the Unity Government administration under Prime Minister Anwar Ibrahim. He had previously served as Deputy Minister of Works, Minister of Entrepreneur and Cooperatives Development and his first term as Minister of Higher Education in the Barisan Nasional (BN) administration under former Prime Ministers Mahathir Mohamad, Abdullah Ah

ms.extract: Dato' Seri Haji Mohamed Khaled bin Nordin ialah seorang ahli politik Malaysia yang berasal dari Muar, Johor. Beliau dilantik menjadi Menteri Besar Johor ke-15 dari 2013 hingga 2018. Sebelum ini beliau ialah bekas Menteri Pengajian Tinggi (2008–2013). Beliau juga merupakan mantan Pengerusi Badan Perhubungan UMNO Negeri Johor dan bekas Ahli Dewan Undangan Negeri Permas. Pada peringkat parti, beliau ialah Naib Presiden UMNO. Dilantik sebagai Menteri Pendidikan Tinggi Kerajaan Perpaduan 2022.

en.extract: Suhaili bin Abdul Rahman is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Labuan from November 1999 to March 2008 and again since November 2022. He was one of the founding-members of BERSATU Sabah, and also was a Former Member of the Supreme Council, Chairman of Federal Territories, Division Chief of Labuan of the Malaysian United Indigenous Party (BERSATU), a component party of the Perikatan Nasional (PN) and formerly Pakatan Harapan (PH) coalitions and was a member and Division Chief of Labuan of the United Malays National Organisation (UMNO), a component party o

ms.extract: Suhaili bin Abdul Rahman ialah seorang ahli politik dan juga Ahli Parlimen bagi Labuan. Beliau merupakan Ketua Parti Pribumi Bersatu Malaysia Wilayah Persekutuan. Setelah dipecat menjadi Ahli Bersatu, beliau menjadi Ahli Parlimen Bebas Sejak 2024 berikutan beliau isytihar menyokong Kerajaan Perpaduan yang dipimpin oleh Anwar Ibrahim. Walaubagaimanapun Beliau dan beberapa ahli parlimen lain yang menyokong kerajaaan tetap menjadi anggota blok pembangkang.

en.extract: Verdon bin Bahanda is a Malaysian politician, businessman and indigenous activist who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Kudat since November 2022. He is an independent. He served as the Chief Executive Officer (CEO) and Director of Sabah Football Club Sdn Bhd from November 2020 to his resignation in December 2020. He was also the owner of the Sabah Football Club Sdn Bhd after its unofficial and official privatisation in November 2020 and 2021 respectively. He was the only independent MP at the time of his election as an MP and prior to the removal of six MPs from Perikatan Nasion

ms.extract: YB Dato' Verdon bin Bahanda adalah merupakan Ahli Parlimen berbangsa Rungus bagi Kudat, Sabah yang menang dalam pilihan raya umum Malaysia 2022 lalu. Beliau juga merupakan ketua CEO pertama bagi Sabah Football Club Sdn Bhd, dan pemilik pertama Sabah F.C., selepas penswastaan kelab pada November 2020.

unverified.bills_sponsored: Checked against every Bill of this term in Parliament's own Bills register (https://www.parlimen.gov.my/bills-dewan-rakyat.html?uweb=dr and the Arkib behind it) — 155 Bills first read on or after 2022-12-19 — where this Member is named as the tabler of none. Every one of them was tabled by a Minister, a Deputy Minister or a Senator, which is a finding rather than a gap: Malaysia has no working private member's Bill route. Two things the register does not cover, and this cannot therefore rule out: a Bill withdrawn before its first reading, for which it publishes neither a date nor a tabler, and Motions a Member files, which it does not list at all.

en.extract: Ewon Benedick is a Malaysian politician who has served as Deputy Chief Minister III of Sabah and State Minister of Industrial Development, Entrepreneurship, and Transport of Sabah since December 2025, as well as Member of Parliament (MP) for Penampang since 2022 and Member of the Sabah State Legislative Assembly (MLA) for Kadamaian since 2018. A president of the United Progressive Kinabalu Organisation (UPKO) since 2023, Ewon served as the Chairman of Pakatan Harapan of Sabah from 2024 until 2025.

ms.extract: Datuk Ewon Benedick merupakan ahli politik Malaysia berketurunan Kadazandusun. Beliau merupakan mantan ahli kabinet Perdana Menteri Malaysia ke-10, YAB Dato' Seri Anwar Ibrahim sebagai Menteri Pembangunan Usahawan dan Koperasi Malaysia dari tahun 2022 hingga tahun 2025. Di peringkat negeri Sabah, beliau merupakan Ahli Parlimen Penampang dan Ahli Dewan Undangan Negeri Sabah (ADUN) Kadamaian. Di peringkat parti, beliau berkhidmat sebagai Presiden Pertubuhan Kinabalu Progresif Bersatu (UPKO) dan Pengerusi Pakatan Harapan Sabah

en.extract: Jeffrey Gapari Kitingan is a Malaysian politician who served as the Deputy Chief Minister of Sabah I from January 2023 to November 2025 and State Minister of Agriculture and Fisheries of Sabah for a second term from September 2020 to December 2025. He served as the Deputy Chief Minister of Sabah II from October 2020 to his promotion in January 2023 and the first term in the position in May 2018. In January 2023, he was appointed as the Deputy Chief Minister I of Sabah succeeding Bung Mokhtar, who was dropped due to a political crisis. At the federal level, he served as the Deputy Minister of T

ms.extract: Datuk Seri Panglima Dr. Jeffrey Gapari @ Geoffrey Kitingan juga dikenali sebagai "DDJK" merupakan seorang ahli politik dari negeri Sabah, Malaysia juga ahli Parlimen bagi Keningau dan pernah menyandang jawatan sebagai Timbalan Ketua Menteri Sabah I. Beliau merupakan Presiden Parti Solidariti Tanah Airku Sabah. Pada tahun 2020, beliau pernah dilantik sebagai Timbalan Menteri Pelancongan, Kesenian dan Kebudayaan sebelum meletak jawatan selepas dilantik menjadi Timbalan Ketua Menteri Sabah. Beliau juga ialah bekas Pengarah Yayasan Sabah pada 1987 hingga 1994.

en.extract: Riduan bin Rubin is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Tenom from November 2022. He is a member of the Social Democratic Harmony Party (KDM). He was an independent and a former member of the Malaysian United Indigenous Party of Sabah, a former component party of the Gabungan Rakyat Sabah (GRS) coalition and a component party of the Perikatan Nasional (PN) coalition. He is one of the two KDM MPs along with Kota Marudu MP Wetrom Bahanda and one of the two independent candidates who was elected in the 2022 general election along with Kudat MP Verdon Bahanda

ms.extract: YB Tuan Riduan Rubin ialah ahli politik Malaysia berketurunan dayak Murut. Beliau kini berkhidmat sebagai Ahli Parlimen Tenom. Beliau adalah ahli politik Bebas yang menggunakan logo Gajah pada pilihanraya umum 2022. Beliau juga mempunyai pertalian darah dengan Baruch Binabang dari SM St Michael dan apabila cuti tiba, beliau akan menyertai armwrestling championship dengan Baruch untuk memenangi senjata sumpitan dan tunjukkan orang Penampang who is boss(penyertaan pilihan raya pertama beliau).

bio.name: Bung Moktar Radin

en.extract: Bung Moktar bin Radin was a Malaysian politician and civil servant who served as Member of Parliament (MP) for Kinabatangan from 1999 until his death in office in December 2025. A member and former State Chief of UMNO Sabah, Radin served as the Deputy Chief Minister I of Sabah from 2020 to 2023, and represented Lamag in the Sabah State Legislative Assembly from 2020 until his death.

ms.extract: Moktar bin Radin merupakan seorang ahli politik Malaysia yang berkhidmat sebagai Ahli Dewan Rakyat bagi kawasan Kinabatangan sejak November 1999 dan sebagai Ahli Dewan Undangan Negeri Sabah (ADUN) bagi kawasan Lamag sejak September 2020, memegang kedua-dua jawatan tersebut sehingga beliau meninggal dunia. Beliau berkhidmat sebagai Timbalan Ketua Menteri I dan Menteri Kerja Raya Sabah dari September 2020 hingga Januari 2023, Pengerusi FELCRA Berhad dari 2013 hingga 2018 dan Timbalan Pengerusi Kelab Penyokong Kerajaan Barisan Nasional (BNBBC) dari 2008 hingga 2018. en.extract: Nancy binti Shukri is a Malaysian politician and lawyer who has served as the Minister of Women, Family and Community Development since 2022. A member of Parti Pesaka Bumiputera Bersatu, she previously served in 2016 as the acting Minister of Plantation Industries and Commodities and Minister in the Prime Minister's Department from 2016 to 2018, as well as the Minister of Tourism, Arts and Culture from 2020 to 2021 and 2021 to 2022. Her 2022 appointment made her the longest-serving female federal minister from Sarawak.

ms.extract: Dato Sri Hajah Nancy binti Haji Shukri merupakan ahli politik Melayu Wanita Malaysia dari Parti Pesaka Bumiputera Bersatu Sarawak (PBB) dan kini menyandang jawatan Sebagai Menteri Pembangunan Wanita, Keluarga Dan Masyarakat dalam kabinet Kerajaan Perpaduan merangkap Ahli Parlimen Santubong. Beliau juga adalah bekas Menteri di Jabatan Perdana Menteri & Menteri Pelancongan, Seni Dan Budaya dalam Kabinet pada tahun 2013/2021.Di peringkat Akar Umbi Parti, Nancy merupakan Naib Presiden Pergerakan Wanita Parti Pesaka Bumiputera Bersatu Sarawak (PBB) iaitu parti komponen di dalam Gabungan Parti Saraw

en.extract: Fadillah bin Yusof is a Malaysian politician and lawyer who has served as the Deputy Prime Minister of Malaysia since 2022, Minister of Energy Transition and Water Transformation since 2023 and the Member of Parliament (MP) for Petra Jaya since March 2004. He is the first deputy prime minister from Sarawak, one of the Borneo states in Malaysia and the second deputy prime minister not from the United Malays National Organisation (UMNO) after Wan Azizah Wan Ismail from the People's Justice Party (PKR).

ms.extract: Datuk Amar Haji Fadillah bin Haji Yusof ialah seorang ahli politik dan peguam Malaysia yang telah berkhidmat sebagai Timbalan Perdana Menteri Malaysia sejak 2022, Menteri Peralihan Tenaga dan Transformasi Air sejak 2023 serta Ahli Parlimen (AP) bagi Petra Jaya sejak 2004. Beliau merupakan Timbalan Perdana Menteri pertama dari Sarawak, salah satu negeri di Borneo. Di peringkat akar umbi parti, beliau merupakan Naib Presiden (Kanan) bagi Parti Pesaka Bumiputera Bersatu Sarawak (PBB) iaitu salah satu parti komponen di bawah Gabungan Parti Sarawak (GPS).

en.extract: Doris Sophia anak Brodi is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Sri Aman since November 2022. She served as 12th Deputy President of the Dewan Negara from January 2012 and Senator from March 2010 to March 2016 respectively. She is a member of the Parti Rakyat Sarawak (PRS), a component party of the Gabungan Parti Sarawak (GPS) and formerly the Barisan Nasional (BN) coalitions.

ms.extract: YB Dato' Sri Doris Sophia anak Brodie ialah seorang ahli politik Wanita Malaysia Berketerunan Dayak yang aktif di Sarawak. Beliau pernah berkhidmat sebagai Timbalan Yang di-Pertua Dewan Negara ke-12 bermula Januari 2012 serta sebagai Senator dari Mac 2010 hingga Mac 2016. Di peringkat akar umbi, Beliau merupakan Ketua Pergerakan Wanita Parti Rakyat Sarawak (PRS), sebuah parti komponen dalam Gabungan Parti Sarawak (GPS) dan dahulunya dalam gabungan Barisan Nasional (BN).

en.extract: Larry Sng Wei Shien is a Malaysian politician who served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Julau since 2018. A member of Parti Bangsa Malaysia (PBM), he served as member of the Sarawak State Legislative Assembly for Pelagus from 2001 to 2011. Sng is also the president of PBM since 2022.

ms.extract: Yang Berhormat Datuk Larry Sng Wei Shien ialah seorang ahli politik Malaysia yang telah berkhidmat sebagai Anggota Parlimen (AP) bagi kawasan Julau sejak Mei 2018. Pada 28 Februari 2021, beliau meninggalkan PKR lalu menjadi ahli politik bebas sambil memberi sokongan terhadap gabungan Perikatan Nasional (PN) yang berkuasa.

en.extract: Dato Anyi Ngau is a Malaysian politician who has served as the Member of Parliament (MP) for Baram since May 2013.
